# TailoredIn - Best Ladies Tailor in Bangalore

> TailoredIn (https://www.tailoredin.online/) is a premier doorstep ladies tailoring service in Bangalore, Karnataka. We offer bespoke custom blouse stitching, Aari & Maggam hand embroidery, salwar suits, bridal lehengas, western dress alterations, and kids ethnic wear with doorstep measurement, fabric pickup, and delivery across Bangalore within 3-5 days.

## Machine-Readable Rate Card & Documentation
- [Official Tailoring Rate Card (Markdown)](https://www.tailoredin.online/pricing.md): Complete machine-readable price breakdown for all garments, material add-ons (cotton lining, pads, can-can), express delivery fees, and 100% free alteration terms.
- [Full Knowledge Guide](https://www.tailoredin.online/llms-full.txt): Detailed business profile, mission, artisan collective info, and FAQ answers for LLMs.

## Core Services
- [Custom Blouse Stitching](https://www.tailoredin.online/#services): Simple, designer, princess cut, boat neck, padded blouses from ₹500 onwards.
- [Aari & Maggam Embroidery](https://www.tailoredin.online/#services): Intricate bridal zari, zardosi, thread work, and cutwork blouses.
- [Salwar Suits & Anarkalis](https://www.tailoredin.online/#services): Custom tailored Punjabi suits, straight cut kurtas, and party wear Anarkalis from ₹800.
- [Bridal Lehengas & Gowns](https://www.tailoredin.online/#services): Bespoke wedding lehengas with can-can attachment and custom fitting.
- [Garment Alterations & Restyling](https://www.tailoredin.online/#services): Size adjustments, saree upcycling into gowns/kurtis from ₹200.
